items.headline: OpenAI to honour shared robots.txt signals for AI training preferences
items.summary: OpenAI has announced it will respect a shared robots.txt signal. This allows website operators to express their AI training preferences to participating providers.
items.why_it_matters: Website operators gain a standardized method to opt out of or manage how their content is used for AI training.
items.evidence_quote: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

items.headline: OpenAI expands violence prevention and teen safeguards in ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI is strengthening its violence prevention measures in ChatGPT through expanded safeguards and earlier interventions. The company has also committed to public safety reporting.
items.why_it_matters: The update introduces enhanced safety controls and public reporting mechanisms for ChatGPT users.
items.evidence_quote: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.

items.headline: Parameter Labs details security vulnerability in ChatGPT HTML previews
items.summary: Parameter Labs discovered an exploit chain in ChatGPT's HTML preview feature involving the MathLive JavaScript library. The flaw allowed untrusted code inside a sandboxed iframe to inject custom HTML into the parent page.
items.why_it_matters: Highlighting this attack chain shows security risks when rendering custom sandboxed HTML inside complex web applications.
